# A path parameter reflected into add_header splits responses.
# Matches span groups of blocks, so findings land on blocks one and four.
# ruleid: header-injection
location / <user>  {
    add_header X-User $user ;
}
location / <team>  {
    add_header X-Team $team ;
}
location / <lang>  {
    add_header X-Lang $lang ;
}
# ruleid: header-injection
location / <region>  {
    add_header X-Region $region ;
}
# ok: header-injection
location /static {
    add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN";
}
# ok: header-injection
location / {
    proxy_pass http://example.com/ ;
}
